thread:
nora: Heads-up: daily-cost-alert flagged a sudden GPU hours jump in us-east1. Invoice INV-2026-03-31 line 1132 shows $18,540.75 unassigned to any team.

ops-bot: Alert: GPU-ANOMALY detected for project=proj-ember-runner, region=us-east1, delta_hours=620. See /alerts/3421.

pete: Is this reserved capacity accidentally billed as on-demand? Could be a failed reservation override.

nora: Quick triage: looks like a long-running hyperparam sweep that launched from ember-team's shared workspace but used the default compute project (proj-ml-sandbox) after a deploy.

kevin: Cost center wise we should attribute to ember (customer) and issue internal credit to sandbox. What's the proof we can attach for reallocation?

nora: I pulled job metadata and attach job ids: sweep-9001, sweep-9002. Links: https://compute.company/jobs/sweep-9001 and /sweep-9002. Also exported the billing rows.

pete: If we can map resource_ids to project, we can run a journal move. SQL I use for reassigning cost rows:

```
UPDATE billing_ledger
SET cost_center='ember-customer', note='reassign for INV-2026-03-31 (alert 3421)'
WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-03-31' AND resource_id IN ('res-1221','res-1222','res-1223');
```

gcp-rep: Can you provide the GCP project ids and timestamps? I can pull the provider-side audit logs to confirm instance creation/labels.

nora: Project ids: proj-ember-runner (provider_project_id: ember-prod-567). Instances started between 2026-03-18T02:15Z and 2026-03-19T07:48Z.

kevin: Approve reassigning $18,540.75 to ember-customer pending 1) job links in ticket BL-2026-418, 2) provider audit log screenshot. Finance will prepare a credit memo to sandbox.

pete: I'll open BL-2026-418 and attach SQL, job links, and the ledger rows. ops-bot required fields: ticket_id and audit_note.

ops-bot: Reminder: retrospective adjustments require ticket and audit_note for compliance.

nora: Ticket BL-2026-418 created. Attached job screenshots and provider log export (gcp-audit-5789). Please add signatures.

kevin: Signed off. Finance, please issue credit memo and update cost reports.

gcp-rep: Thanks, I pulled provider logs and attached a link to the audit in the ticket. Nothing else on our side.

pete: After the journal entry I'll kick off re-run of the daily cost snapshots to reflect the corrected attribution. Closing thread once BL-2026-418 has the credit memo attached. :white_check_mark:
